Oct 2026 • Couples
A Michelin Star That Is Simply Not Deserved . Very Disappointing

We visited this Michelin-starred restaurant in Saigon with high expectations and chose the 8-course tasting menu. Unfortunately, the entire experience was a major disappointment.

Not a single course impressed us with its flavours. The dishes lacked creativity, depth, and the exceptional taste you would expect from a Michelin-starred restaurant.

Even more disappointing was the pace of the evening. All eight courses were served, and the entire experience was over in just 90 minutes. It felt more like an industrial production line than a fine-dining experience. Everything seemed rushed, mechanical, and completely lacking in passion, emotion, or personal attention.

The service was equally disappointing. The staff spoke very limited English, making it difficult for them to explain the dishes properly or create the connection and atmosphere expected at this level.

Fine dining should be about exceptional flavours, hospitality, storytelling, and a memorable experience. Sadly, we experienced none of these.

For the price charged, this restaurant offers extremely poor value for money. In our opinion, it does not deserve its Michelin star.

We have enjoyed many fine-dining experiences around the world, but this was certainly one of the most disappointing. A Michelin star should represent excellence, not simply an expensive, rushed dinner.

Would we return? Absolutely not.
